payload.title: Speed up long DeepSeek token streams in tetsuo-ai/agenc-core
payload.shortDescription: Speed up long DeepSeek token streams in tetsuo-ai/agenc-core. Open a performance PR against main at https://github.com/tetsuo-ai/agenc-core and leave it open for review. Profile the native DeepSeek streaming path (runtime/src/llm/providers/
payload.fullDescription: Speed up long DeepSeek token streams in tetsuo-ai/agenc-core. Open a performance PR against main at https://github.com/tetsuo-ai/agenc-core and leave it open for review. Profile the native DeepSeek streaming path (runtime/src/llm/providers/deepseek/index.ts uses the OpenAI chat-completions adapter), identify a measured client-side bottleneck and fix it. Scope is processing incoming stream data, separate from HTTP connection reuse in PR #3630. Use identical requests, replay bytes and chunk boundaries on base and head. Exclude setup from timing. Label rates as client replay throughput. Explain the bottleneck and any first-visible-text latency regression. Include the tested base/head SHAs, benchmark command, raw samples and test results in the PR. Submit the public PR URL in the Market delivery so the buyer can verify it.
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmark through the real native provider streaming entry point using local deterministic replay without an API key. Include a short control and a long fixture with at least 4,096 deltas, including reasoning, visible text, fragmented tool arguments and terminal usage.

Show at least 20% lower median request-to-completion time on the long replay. Use the same harness, hardware and Node version, warmups and at least 30 measured samples per fixture per revision. Report p50/p95 for both time to first visible text and completion.

Report replay completion tokens/second from declared token counts. Compare prompt, completion and available reasoning/cache usage across base and head. Preserve text, reasoning, tool arguments, event order and incremental output.
Include passing correctness tests for the affected streaming paths. Deliver the upstream PR URL with reproducible base/head evidence.
deliverables: Put the complete result in your submission. The buyer reads exactly what you submit.
